parts.text: The geologist needs to know what rocks the drill has reached , so every so often a sample is obtained with a coring bit. every so often 时而，有时候（时间状语） It cuts a clean cylinder of rock, from which can be seen the strata the drill has been cutting through . … from which the strata the drill has been cutting through can be seen. 正常语序 from which... (主语后置) 非限定性定语从句 Once we get down to the oil, it usually flows to the surface because great pressure, either from gas or water, is pushing it. get down to... 下降到...；认真严肃地做某事 This pressure must be under control , and we control it by means of the mud which we circulate down the drill pipe . be under control 在控制之中 under + 名词 在...状态之中 We endeavour to avoid the old, romantic idea of a gusher, which wastes oil and gas . endeavor / make every endeavor to do 竭尽全力做某事 romantic adj. impractical 不切实际的 定语从句充当原因状语 which wastes oil and gas We want it to stay down the hole until we can lead it off in a controlled manner. lead it off 引走；导出
She's going to come back every so often. 她会偶尔回来一下。
You're bound to mistime a tackle every so often. 你肯定会有错估进攻时机的时候。
Occasionally, I enjoy reading a classic novel.
We meet up for coffee from time to time.

headers: every so often 每隔一段时间；偶尔地（中性，指不频繁且不规律的发生）
sometimes 有时（最常用，中性，指在某些时候发生）
occasionally 偶尔地；间或（比 sometimes 频率更低，较正式）
at times 有时；间或（强调在某一时刻或某些时候发生）
now and then 偶尔；时而（口语化，与 every so often 相似，指不规律地发生）
now and again 偶尔；时不时地（与 now and then 同义，常用于英式英语）
once in a while 偶尔；难得（强调不经常发生，频率较低）
from time to time 时常；偶尔（指持续一段时间，间歇性地发生）
rows: We get together for dinner every so often, perhaps once a month. 我们每隔一段时间会一起吃晚饭，可能一个月一次。
Sometimes I like to work from home to avoid the commute. 有时我喜欢在家工作以避免通勤。
He only drinks coffee occasionally, preferring tea most of the time. 他只是偶尔喝咖啡，大部分时间更喜欢喝茶。
The work can be very stressful at times, but it is usually rewarding. 这项工作有时会压力很大，但通常是值得的。
I still go back to visit my childhood neighborhood now and then. 我仍然偶尔回去看看我童年的街坊邻里。
The old engine coughs and splutters now and again, but it still runs. 这台旧发动机时而会发出咳嗽声和噼啪声，但它仍然能运转。
We splurge on an expensive meal once in a while to celebrate special occasions. 我们偶尔会奢侈地吃一顿大餐来庆祝特殊的场合。
She likes to reread her favorite classic novels from time to time. 她喜欢时不时地重读她最喜欢的经典小说。

parts.text: She showed me her photo album, from which I selected several pictures.从中我选了几张照片

Let us get down to fundamentals and agree that the young are after all human beings -- people just like their elders .
There's no need to flap—I've got everything under control. 不必担心—一切都已在我控制之中。
We've got to get the economy under control or it will literally eat us up. 我们必须控制住经济，否则它真地就会把我们困住。
He believes that from a military standpoint, the situation is under control. 他认为从军事角度来看，局势已得到控制。

headers: get sth. under control 控制住...
get out of control / hand 失控
rows: ...Do you think they’ll ever get that under control?他们会控制住那个吗?
...the fire got out of hand and we had to call the fire department. A day may begin well enough, but suddenly everything seems to get out of control .

headers: do / try one’s utmost to do 竭尽全力做某事
go to great lengths to do 竭尽全力做某事
spare no effort to do 不遗余力地做某事
go all out to do 全力以赴地做某事
rows: Though the doctor did his best, the patient's recovery was slow . You play to win, and the game has little meaning unless you do your utmost to win .
The man went to great lengths to prove that the diamonds were real .
I will spare no effort to learn English.我将不遗余力地学习英语
John’s really gone all out this time.
